The issuer displays strong scale and top-line revenue ($22.3B) alongside consistent profitability ($879M net income), but its capital structure is significantly leveraged with a high liabilities-to-assets ratio (~81%), low equity cushion ($5.38B), and a negative working capital position (current ratio of ~0.89). While the operational cash generation and positive retained earnings provide reasonable debt service capability, the elevated leverage and potential liquidity tightness cap the credit profile in the lower investment-grade spectrum.

DECISION: BBB
